check: default-off identity of the brain-11 training and gate code against m4 (c953758)
method: The same script (scratchpad m4b/brain11/identity.py) ran on a git archive of m4 and on this branch before any brain-11 candidate existed: a brain-controlled and a PD-controlled DAgger collection (parent motor-brain-10-tracking-05, 4 steep courses, 14 s, seed 101) with fast-brain-10b's collection settings (brain-10 caps on 60% of the drones, slow legs, label teacher attitude 4 / vertical 5 with turn relief 0.5, label lead 6 ticks), its brake mask and brake/balance weights, a refit (ridge 0.003, smooth 100, rows 0.3/1/1), and the brain-10 gate parts hover and swaps for fast-brain-10b under configs/brain10_gates.json. None of the new options was used (no --pilot deployed, no climbing caps, no hill share, default brake level, no turn brakes).
compared: refit (changed tensors, readout weight and bias)
result: identical: every tensor bit-identical and every metric equal
rechecked: Re-run on the final code (after the post-freeze training options --yaw-holds, --pilot-share and --cruise-weight, and after fixing a logging-only slip that had dropped the synthetic_cap_events count from rollout rows): identical again.
also: The new gate part swaps_delayed (replay_window) reproduces fast-brain-10b's G3 controller-minus-PD values at +1 s exactly (-0.115, -0.501, -0.756, +0.549, +0.889, -0.255, -0.657, +0.262, +0.261); the new part full_pilot reproduces the round-4 integration surrogate of fast-brain-10b under the full pilot exactly (steep 3000-3007 summary identical; 28/28 finished, 12 contacts, 29 high passes, chatter 0.00289).
scope: surrogate code only; not flight evidence
